warnings: S1 prints a short-span and a long-span section with the same reinforcement -- merged to one entry. Top bars over the supports (RB9@0.20m, L/3 on one side and L/4 on the other) are additional_bars; the bottom mesh is main_bar.

ST-1 and ST-2 are the same detail (waist 0.15, tread 0.25, riser 0.18, three risers drawn from ระดับดิน); they differ only in the beam they land on (ST-1 on B2, ST-2 on B3). The S-02 plan marks the stairs ST-01 / ST-02: by bearing beam ST-01 (row G, beam B3) matches ST-2 and ST-02 (row B, beam B2) matches ST-1 -- see the S-02 file. Marks kept as printed here.
